newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Valora see 70 pct boost in net profit.
newsitem.headline: Valora see 70 pct boost in net profit.

text.p: Swiss retailer, caterer and bedding maker Valora Holding AG said it expected to achieve a targeted 70 percent rise in net profits this year.
A Valora statement said the goal looked reachable based on results from the first 10 months of 1996, with sales generally better in the second half than in the first six months.

"Based on the short-term calculation of results in the first 10 months of the current year, the Valora group will in all likelihood reach its target of boosting group profit by around 70 percent," it said.
Valora posted a net profit of 41.2 million francs last year.

Preliminary data showed annual sales up around one percent by the end of November, compared with a 0.3 percent fall by the end of June. "The sales trend is generally slightly better in the second half as in the first," it said.
